findings.title: Swapped light/dark lightness in embedded meta link
findings.body: In .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a the old rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The change made it dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)). The light-theme branch should stay at 30% with dark branch at 70%, i.e. 30%/70% like every other 30% conversion. As written light themes get a 70% lightened color that is much too faint and dark themes get 30% instead of 70%.

findings.title: Wrong lightness for custom-message-length on mobile
findings.body: Old rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%). New rule is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)). The light side changed from 70% to 30%. Desktop modal.scss for the same selector correctly uses 70%/30%. Mobile will now render much darker hint text in light themes and is inconsistent with desktop.

findings.title: Wrong lightness for topic-map h3 on mobile
findings.body: Old rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%). New rule is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light branch should be 20% with dark branch 80%, as desktop/topic-post.scss h3 correctly does with 20%/80%. As written mobile light themes get a 50% lightened heading instead of 20%, losing contrast and diverging from desktop.

findings.title: Lost distinct color for group-member name
findings.body: Old .group-member-info .name was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). New is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)), identical to .title below it. It should be 30%/70% per the 100-minus convention used everywhere else and per common/base/user.scss which keeps 30%/70% for the same elements. Light themes get too-light names and the name/title distinction is lost.

findings.title: Lost distinct color for group-member name on mobile
findings.body: Old .group-member-info .name was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). New is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)), identical to .title. It should be 30%/70% to preserve the light-theme value and match common/base/user.scss. As written mobile light themes render the name lighter than designed.
